$Comment: A Pumpkin Fiend's attack, the id its role names as Attack. It is the game's Skeleton Fighter attack (Root_NPC_Skeleton_Fighter_Attack) with the Kweebec Razorleaf's three spear moves in its chain: the left swing, the right swing and the stab, each playing the Kweebec Sapling's own spear animations (Kweebec_Spear), which fit the fiend because its model keeps the sapling's node names. Each swing in a row takes the next move. The hit lands through the role's Melee_Damage, so the fiend's damage is tuned on its role. A fiend stunned by a hit (Hit_Interrupt_Stunned) does not start an attack.
